data.name: Theater District
data.headline: Experience the colorful history of theatre in Boston!
data.description:
Join us for a unique 2 hour Theater History program that includes both Boston By Foot's guided Theater District tour followed by a guided tour of the interior of the Historic Boch Center Wang Theatre & Folk Americana Roots Hall of Fame. Presented in collaboration with The Boch Center Wang Theatre. All are welcome.

##About Boston By Foot's Theater District walking tour

Take a walking tour of Boston's Theater District. Join your Boston By Foot guide for walking tour of Boston's Theater District exploring the exteriors of such theatres as the Opera House, the Majestic, Wilbur, Colonial, and the Paramount. Experience stories about the varied history of theatre in Boston, from the Colonial period to Boston's heyday as a tryout venue for some of the country's greatest plays and musicals before they went to Broadway.

##About the Historic Boch Center Wang Theatre interior tour

Enjoy a behind-the-scenes tour of one of Boston’s most prominent landmarks, the historic Boch Center Wang Theatre - plus get an exclusive look at the Folk Americana Roots Hall of Fame and its multiple exhibits! Learn about the theatre’s architectural highlights and unique history – from its hotel roots and glamorous days as a movie “cathedral”, to today’s role as an impressive venue for performances and events. Stand on the stage graced by Mikhail Baryshnikov, Queen, Elton John, Lady Gaga, Liza Minnelli and more! Explore The Music Hall and learn about the home of the first Folk Americana Roots Hall of Fame - featuring memorabilia and photographs of music legends such as Neil Young, Bruce Springsteen, Joan Baez, and Bob Dylan

data.cancellation_notes:
- Please arrive at least 10 minutes early to meet your guide. Late admittance is not guaranteed. 
- Public tours can be rebooked on another available tour, or canceled for full credit as a gift card, with at least 24hrs notice. Customers can conveniently cancel or rebook public tour registrations using the "change booking" and "cancel booking" links in the confirmation and reminder emails. Cancellations less than 24hrs prior to the tour start or no shows cannot be credited.
- Private tours can be canceled up to 4 days before the start for a full refund. Private tour cancellations made within 4 days of the tour date incur a small cancellation fee, though they can be rebooked for no additional fees. Contact us to cancel or rebook a private tour. 
- All tours are held in all weather - rain or shine. Please be prepared for the weather and to walk and stand outdoors on your tour. In case of tour cancellation by Boston By Foot due to extreme weather or unforeseen circumstances, you will be offered a refund or exchange. If groups choose to cancel a tour due to weather, the above policy stands.
